scope: Bounded visual comparison of newly frozen LH and partial RH switchgear; no further renders or model/manifest/registry changes.

method.blender_read_only: Both final source files opened with Blender4.3.2 CPU1 to identify actual editable shell/control objects. No render or save.
method.comparison: Native-resolution actual documentary images and actual front/Cycles and driver/quarter Babylon views; local feature/content inspection only. Documentary cameras are not calibrated.
no_claim: No physical dimension derived from pixels
No inferred electrical function from cap colour

supported_local_observations.observation: TURN and the two directional arrows are above the main shell seam in the corrected candidate, as in the readable related front photograph. The old under-seam placement should not be re-reported as a current defect.

Horizontal turn slot occupies roughly two-fifths to slightly under half of the frontal shell width. The corrected recessed rectangular panel and narrower central selector are present. The earlier over-wide73percent slot defect is not present in these views.
supported_local_observations.limit: Qualitative uncalibrated local proportion, not a measured target tolerance.

supported_local_observations.observation: Three-control arrangement is recognisable: upper vertical rocker, middle lateral selector and lower rounded-bottom horn tongue. Shell crown/corners are now rounded; no major former faceting is visible in these views.
supported_local_observations.limit: Actual section depths, front-to-back proportion and control protrusion/travel are not calibrated to the related photos.

supported_local_observations.observation: A small red area above the physical RH grip and a dark housing are genuinely visible in the current official photos. A red upper control on the RH candidate is therefore supported at this coarse level.
supported_local_observations.limit: The source red area spans only approximately7–9 native pixels across in rotation06. Its exact top profile, bezel and actuator geometry cannot be resolved from that image.

concrete_visible_differences.observation: Both headlamp symbols in the candidate have angular/pentagonal lamp outlines and three detached beam strokes. The readable related photo has rounded D-like lamp bowls and a denser set of short beam strokes. The candidate white markings are simplified substitutes rather than faithful copies of the visible outlines.
concrete_visible_differences.next_action: If this related JB401400 front is retained as modelling target, trace the actual observed rounded symbol contours and stroke layout in original vector geometry. This does not certify their presence on the unresolved exact RDC variant.

concrete_visible_differences.observation: The photographed horn symbol has a curved/oval central body with flared ends. The candidate substitutes an angular triangular/trapezoidal horn symbol. Its content is understandable but its visible contour differs.
concrete_visible_differences.next_action: Retain the function label but reproduce the observed symbol contour if fidelity to this related part is claimed.

reserved_shapes_not_declared_errors.reserved: Candidate cap is a tall flat-topped cylinder on a dark collar. Only a coarse roundish red patch is resolved in official images. Top flatness/doming, cylindrical side height, edge radius, collar and push mechanism remain estimates. This audit neither accepts that exact shape nor invents a correction from those pixels.

Official RH housing includes dark relief/plane changes below the red patch, but mirror stalk, bar, grip and nearby hardware obscure attribution. The almost plain candidate front is partial/simplified. Do not label any unresolved black relief as an extra functional button or declare the complete current housing reproduced.

Additional upper-right white symbol is visible on the related front, but intentionally absent from the current candidate because exact RDC layout is unresolved. This is an explicit variant omission, not a newly diagnosed fabricated feature or automatic prescription to add a switch.

Housing dimensions, tube fit, shell wall, split plane, hidden bosses/screw locations, back depth, actuator protrusion and movement remain working estimates. A source collection or a passing collision/GLB check cannot settle their observed shape fidelity.

variant_and_occlusion_constraints.consequence: Readable retailer photos constrain a related part. The tiny current RDC LH silhouette does not identify it as JB401400.

Actually inspected PF401417/PF401417 package and Bikebox all-black photos show a different control layout without the current red top. Do not merge their light/starter labels or black controls into the current partial red-top candidate.
Referenced in existing research as another related all-black alternative; no new PF401408 image was independently inspected during this bounded audit, so no new geometric claim is drawn from it.
Exact RH part number, red-control function, detents, electrical behaviour and other hidden commands remain unknown. A geometric0.4mm review push is not evidence of a real pushbutton mechanism.

technical_vs_artistic: Actual source/export hashes and successful import identify the inspected revisions. They do not establish exact reference contours, dimensions, model identity or user artistic acceptance. No new geometric defect beyond the two definite marking differences is asserted without sufficient views.
scope_of_completion: Bounded audit complete against the images recorded by SHA; later final Blender captures may extend evidence but do not retroactively validate unresolved detail.
